title: Mormonism as a UFO religion: Joseph Smith's contacts and downloads

tellings.quote: And if you actually look into Mormonism, it's kind of a UFO religion.

plain: Mormonism, the faith Joseph Smith founded in the United States in the 1820s and after, is "kind of a UFO religion" if you actually look into it. That is the view of a researcher named Matthew Pines, who says so to Michels in passing without naming a source. He points to Joseph Smith's contacts and the revelations Smith received, which would make one of America's own religions a story of contact with something from beyond.
